analysis_rule: share of the 16 disputed items judged `answers` (Wilson 95%); `partly_answers` counted as answers and as not (bracket); `unsure` excluded and counted. Controls: share of the 4 judged `answers` or `partly_answers`. If most disputed pages answer, O1's credit holds where direct judgment rejected it (the verifier misses moved answers); if few do, direct judgment holds. Agreement with the 53 is estimated, never claimed per page beyond the sample
blinding: verifier decision and variant id hidden; all items from one edited variant (not blind to arm)

sample.rule: random.sample per stratum, seeded by sha256(seed_label:stratum); order seeded likewise
